scope: Automated structural match simulations across all 65 authentic starter decks
sourceFinding: The original playbook help text states that Lead Off pages are fixed, remaining pages are shuffled, and one random page is drawn at the beginning of each turn.

primaryCauses: Move_Type was incorrectly treated as an offensive play requirement.
The engine refilled to five after a move instead of drawing one page at the beginning of each turn.
Passing or losing control did not draw the new turn's page.

patch: Move_Type is now treated as the move/counter state, not a blanket offensive legality requirement.
Explicit source-text restrictions such as opponent-on-mat remain enforced.
One page is drawn when a new turn begins after control changes.
Automatic refill-to-five after ordinary moves and Gameplans is removed.
Fixed original Lead Off pages remain unchanged.

postPatchStructuralSimulation.observedMovesPerSimulation: approximately 30-37 before deck exhaustion in the simplified audit model
postPatchStructuralSimulation.note: Runtime card-effect and pin/submission verification continues in later passes.
